# Avadh Girls' Degree College (AGDC)

> > NAAC-accredited women's degree college in Lucknow affiliated with University of Lucknow, offering BA, MA, and professional programs with ISO certification and IQAC quality assurance.

Avadh Girls' Degree College is a premier women's institution in Lucknow offering undergraduate and postgraduate programs under the National Education Policy (NEP) framework. The college maintains strong institutional partnerships with NAAC, NIRF, IGNOU, ICSSR, ICHR, and the UP Higher Education Department, emphasizing academic excellence, student development, and quality assurance through ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certifications.

## Key Topics

- NAAC accreditation
- IQAC (Internal Quality Assurance Cell)
- University of Lucknow affiliation
- NEP (National Education Policy) curriculum
- NIRF ranking
- ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certification
- Women's higher education
- Career counselling and placement services
- Student councils and committees
- NCC (National Cadet Corps)
- Swayam Portal online learning
- ICSSR and ICHR research partnerships
- Nazrana-e-Avadh college magazine
- Scholarships for SC/ST/OBC/EWS students
- Extracurricular activities and clubs

## Academic Programs

- [Bachelor of Arts](https://agdc.ac.in/pages/ba): BA undergraduate program with NEP curriculum and major-minor subjects
- [Political Science](https://agdc.ac.in/pages/political-science): Political Science department with MA program and faculty details
- [Physical Education](https://agdc.ac.in/pages/physical-education): Physical Education department offering BA program, sports, and yoga
- [E-Content](https://agdc.ac.in/pages/e-content): Digital resources and online learning e-content for students
